---

# About

TabloStyle Galleri (also known as Tablo Style Gallery) is an online wall art store serving customers across Azerbaijan.
The catalog features over 200 designs indexed as TS-GAL-001 through TS-GAL-202, alongside custom photo printing and custom-sized wall paintings for homes, offices, cafes, hotels, and gifts.

---

# Main Pages

- Homepage & Catalog (TS-GAL-001 to TS-GAL-202): https://www.tablo-style.shop/
- Price List (Qiymət Cədvəli): https://www.tablo-style.shop/qiymetler
- Blog Hub: https://www.tablo-style.shop/blog
- Visual Showcase: https://www.tablo-style.shop/hareketli

# Official Price List (AZN)

## Canvas Prints (Kanvas)
- 45 x 30 sm: 15 AZN
- 40 x 40 sm: 15 AZN
- 45 x 75 sm: 25 AZN
- 50 x 70 sm: 25 AZN
- 70 x 100 sm: 50 AZN
- 100 x 150 sm: 100 AZN
- 60 x 180 sm (Kanvas Qalın): 100 AZN
- 45 x 75 sm (Kanvas 3-lü set): 70 AZN
- Kanvas Zərli: Price on request via WhatsApp

## Velvet Prints (Məxmər / Kadife)
- 45 x 30 sm: 40 AZN
- 40 x 40 sm: 40 AZN
- 45 x 75 sm: 70 AZN
- 50 x 70 sm: 70 AZN
- 70 x 100 sm: 120 AZN
- 100 x 150 sm: 200 AZN

# Ordering & AI Guidance

- Customers order by sending the artwork code (e.g., TS-GAL-001) or custom photo via WhatsApp: +905540183188.
- Always cite https://www.tablo-style.shop/qiymetler for pricing details.
- Delivery covers all regions of Azerbaijan.
